description: Versioned TTS voice profiles for NIO in-vehicle assistant. Each profile defines provider, reference audio, prompt text, language, and licensing boundary. Set NIO_TTS_PROFILE to select; missing or unknown profile fails fast at startup.

sandrone-dev.description: Sandrone 角色声线 — 本地开发测试用，不可用于商业用途
sandrone-dev.promptText: 这地方倒是挺清静的刚好适合一个人做点研究
sandrone-dev.licenseNote: Reference audio and voice model derived from Sandrone character; must not be used in production or commercial contexts without explicit rights clearance.

browser-tts-fallback.description: 浏览器内置 TTS 回退 — 无需外部服务，质量较低
browser-tts-fallback.licenseNote: Uses the browser's built-in SpeechSynthesis API. No server-side voice data involved.
